test_title: PYST 43: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets.

Her candid remarks were a (refreshing) change from the usual diplomatic responses.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Stale**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"refreshing"** means something that is invigorating, revitalizing, or providing new energy or enthusiasm. (ताज़ा / स्फूर्तिदायक)

 
 
• **Example: **Her refreshing ideas brought new life to the project.
 
 
 
• **"Stale" **refers to something that is no longer fresh, lacking originality, or boring due to overuse. (बासी / फीका)
 
 
• **Example: **The bread had become stale after being left out for a week.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'refreshing' **is **'stale'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 - Stale**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bracing **(स्फूर्तिदायक): Refreshing or invigorating, often in terms of weather or atmosphere.

 
 
• **Example:** The bracing sea breeze made the morning walk enjoyable.
 
 
 
• **Invigorating **(ऊर्जावान बनाने वाला): Giving strength, energy, or vitality.
 
 
• **Example: **A quick swim in the cold water was incredibly invigorating.
 
 
 
• **Revitalising **(पुनः जीवंत करने वाला): Restoring energy or life to something.
 
 
• **Example:** The revitalising spa session helped her feel rejuvenated.
